quote: DEGREE ... learns to summarize the passage into a natural sentence following a predefined template
Event extraction (EE) aims to extract events, each of which consists of a trigger and several participants (arguments) with their specific roles, from a given passage.

We propose DEGREE (Data-Efficient GeneRation-Based Event Extraction), a generation-based model that takes a passage and a manually designed prompt as the input, and learns to summarize the passage into a natural sentence following a predefined template...
outputs: natural sentences following predefined templates that replace placeholders with event triggers and arguments
natural language sentences following predefined templates that represent event structures

quote: Evaluation metrics. We consider the same criteria in prior works. (1) Trigger F1-score: ... (2) Argument F1-score: ...
We consider the same criteria in prior works... Trigger F1-score: an trigger is correctly identified... Argument F1-score: an argument is correctly identified...

Evaluation metrics. We consider the same criteria in prior works. (1) Trigger F1-score: an trigger is correctly identified (Tri-I) if its offset matches the gold one; it is correctly classified (Tri-C) if its event type also matches the gold one. (2) Argument F1-score: an argument is correctly identified (Arg-I) if its offset and event type match the gold ones; it is correctly classified (Arg-C) if its role matches as well.
